# korao.ai — Premium AI Domain For Sale

## Overview

korao.ai is a premium .ai domain listing. The domain offers a short, brandable, and memorable name native to the artificial intelligence industry. It is positioned as a digital asset for AI startups, LLM developers, AI tool builders, automation platforms, and next-generation tech products.

## Why .ai?

.ai is the country code top-level domain (ccTLD) for Anguilla. Due to the AI industry boom, .ai has become the de facto TLD for artificial intelligence companies worldwide. Short, pronounceable .ai domain names are increasingly scarce, making remaining premium names valuable long-term digital assets.

## Domain Characteristics

- **Name**: korao.ai
- **Length**: Short, single-word brandable
- **Pronunciation**: Intuitive, globally accessible
- **TLD**: .ai (AI industry standard)
- **Vertical fit**: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, LLMs, AI SaaS, automation
- **Memorability**: High recall, easy to spell, clean brand identity

## Use Cases

| Category | Application |
|----------|-------------|
| AI Startup | Primary brand domain for a new AI venture |
| LLM/AI Lab | Research lab or model development hub |
| AI Tool | Product landing page for AI-powered tools |
| SaaS Platform | AI automation or intelligent SaaS brand |
| Venture Brand | Holding company or investment brand in AI space |

## Marketing Positioning

korao.ai is marketed as a premium digital asset. The landing page emphasizes three value dimensions:
1. **Brand Value** — Short, modern, unique brand name with high recall
2. **AI Vertical Fit** — Natively suited for the AI industry
3. **Premium Investment** — Scarcity of quality .ai names creates long-term asset value

## Acquisition Process

Interested parties submit an inquiry through the site form. The process simulates a secure domain transfer via escrow (Escrow.com or Dan.com). Offer history is tracked locally.

## Page Sections

1. **Hero** — Brand headline "Korao.ai — Define Your AI Future" with background video, CTA to inquire
2. **Domain Value** — Three cards: Brandable Simplicity, AI Vertical Fit, Premium .ai Investment
3. **Interactive Explorer** — Tab panel with brand preview, API sandbox (simulated), and investment comparison
